placeholder._source_notes: Rough literature-derived stand-ins for Phase 3's dry run only. sleep_current_ua ~ typical ESP32 deep-sleep datasheet figure; wake_up_uj/sensor_read_uj/tx_uj ~ order-of-magnitude figures consistent with Giordano et al. 2023 (ACM ENSsys) and Hinostroza et al. 2026 (Sensors) — see docs/SenseSmart_Literature_Survey.md. kalman_* and ml_* are rough compute-cost guesses, NOT measured — do not quote these in any results section.

measured._source_notes: Fill in from Track B Phase 5 — real INA219 measurements. Every value below must be a number (not null) before running with energy_source='measured'.

estimated._source_notes: Fallback if the INA219 measurement doesn't come through in time — see Track B's 'Fallback' subsection under Phase 5 (ESP32 datasheet current x on-device-timed duration). Every value below must be a number (not null) before running with energy_source='estimated'.
